Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment used a TMT 10-plex labeling strategy with an SPS-MS3 acquisition method on an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos to minimize ratio compression. While the study discusses 'Differentially Culturable Tubercle Bacilli' (DCTB), this refers to a microbiological culture assay, not a proteomics enrichment; the proteomics was performed on the BALF supernatant (host proteome) after albumin/IgG depletion.

scope: We also analyzed BALF supernatant from these same clinically cured patients and an equal number of active TB samples, using shotgun proteomics.

For the proteomics analysis of BALF supernatant, five EOT patients also analyzed for DCTB (Figure 1), were chosen (including PID338 who subsequently relapsed) and BALF from five active TB (before treatment initiation) patients were included as a comparison.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The analyzed material is BALF supernatant. While this is a biological fluid and not a traditional cell lysate, within the provided ontology mapping rules, it does not meet the criteria for 'purified protein or complex' (no affinity capture/purification of a specific target) or other specialized scopes. It is treated as the bulk proteome of the sampled material.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically compares the BALF supernatant of patients at the end of a 6-month anti-TB treatment (EOT) versus patients with active TB before treatment initiation. While the study also discusses a 'DCTB assay' and PET-CT imaging, the proteomics analysis is a case-control comparison of disease state (Active vs. Cured).
